title: Grade 1
summary: Rhythm, the stave, treble and bass clefs, the first four major keys, tonic triads, interval numbers and the language of performance.

units.title: Note values, rests, ties and dots
units.summary: How long sounds and silences last, and how ties and dots lengthen notes.

units.title: Bars and simple time
units.summary: Bars, bar-lines, 2/4 3/4 4/4, completing bars and grouping notes clearly.
refinements: Rest placement within bars is introduced here at a basic level because the outline lists rests at Grade 1; full rest-grouping rules remain in Grade 2 (see OPEN_QUESTIONS Q3).

units.title: Keyboard, stave, clefs and ledger lines
units.summary: Letter names, the keyboard, the stave, treble and bass clefs, middle C and writing notes.

units.title: Sharps, flats and naturals
units.summary: Accidentals on the keyboard and stave, how long they last and how they are cancelled.

units.title: Tones, semitones and major keys
units.summary: Semitones and tones; C, G, D and F major scales; key signatures; degrees by number.

units.title: Tonic triads and intervals
units.summary: Tonic triads in root position and interval numbers above the tonic.

units.title: Terms, signs and melody reading
units.summary: Tempo, dynamics, performance directions and articulation, applied to short original melodies.
refinements: Music-in-context lesson added: the official outline asks questions about a melody, which the source book does not cover.

nodes.title: Beats, crotchets, minims and semibreves
nodes.objective: Feel a steady beat and compare crotchets, minims and semibreves by how many beats they last.

nodes.title: Quavers and semiquavers
nodes.objective: Recognise quavers and semiquavers and say how many fit into a crotchet.

nodes.title: Flags and beams
nodes.objective: Recognise the same quavers and semiquavers written with flags or joined by beams.

nodes.title: Rests
nodes.objective: Match each Grade 1 note value with its rest and read the semibreve and minim rests correctly.

nodes.title: Ties
nodes.objective: Add the values of tied notes to find how long the sound lasts.

nodes.title: Dotted notes
nodes.objective: Work out the length of a dotted note and choose between a tie and a dot.

nodes.title: Practice: Long and short sounds
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: long and short sounds
nodes.objective: Revisit earlier material so it stays fresh.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Long and short sounds
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Bars and bar-lines
nodes.objective: Explain how bar-lines group beats and why the first beat of a bar is stronger.

nodes.title: Time signatures 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4
nodes.objective: Read the top and bottom numbers of 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4 (and the C sign).

nodes.title: Complete the bar
nodes.objective: Complete bars in 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4 using notes, dotted notes and rests.

nodes.title: Grouping notes to show the beat
nodes.objective: Beam quavers and semiquavers so that every beat is easy to see, including the 4/4 half-bar convention.

nodes.title: Ties or single notes?
nodes.objective: Replace unnecessary ties with single or dotted notes, and keep ties that show the beat.

nodes.title: Rests in a bar
nodes.objective: Use a semibreve rest for a silent bar and place simple rests on the beat in 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4.

nodes.title: Practice: Count the beat
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Count the beat
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Letter names on the keyboard
nodes.objective: Name white keys from A to G using the groups of black keys.

nodes.title: The stave: lines and spaces
nodes.objective: Count the lines and spaces of a stave from the bottom and say whether a note is on a line or in a space.

nodes.title: Treble clef: notes on the lines
nodes.objective: Read and place the five treble-clef line notes (E, G, B, D, F).

nodes.title: Treble clef: notes in the spaces
nodes.objective: Read and place the four treble-clef space notes (F, A, C, E).

nodes.title: The bass clef
nodes.objective: Read and place bass-clef line and space notes, using F on the fourth line as a guide.

nodes.title: Middle C and ledger lines
nodes.objective: Read and write middle C on a ledger line in both clefs and find it on the keyboard.

nodes.title: Writing notes neatly
nodes.objective: Write note-heads, stems and flags on the stave with stems on the correct side.

nodes.title: Practice: The keyboard and the stave
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: The keyboard and the stave
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Sharps, flats and naturals on the keyboard
nodes.objective: Name black keys as sharps or flats and explain what a natural sign does.

nodes.title: Accidentals on the stave
nodes.objective: Write an accidental before a note on the same line or space and read notes with accidentals.

nodes.title: How long does an accidental last?
nodes.objective: Decide which notes in a bar an accidental affects, including tied notes over a bar-line.

nodes.title: Cancelling accidentals
nodes.objective: Use a natural sign to cancel a sharp or flat and spot unnecessary accidentals.

nodes.title: Practice: Sharps, flats and naturals
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Sharps, flats and naturals
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: Semitones and tones
nodes.objective: Find semitones and tones on the keyboard.

nodes.title: Building C major
nodes.objective: Build the C major scale and mark where its semitones fall.

nodes.title: G and D major: raising notes
nodes.objective: Build G and D major by raising notes to keep the major pattern.

nodes.title: F major: lowering a note
nodes.objective: Build F major by lowering the fourth note.

nodes.title: Keys and key signatures
nodes.objective: Recognise and write the key signatures of C, G, D and F major in both clefs.

nodes.title: Writing scales with and without key signatures
nodes.objective: Write C, G, D and F major ascending and descending in both clefs, with and without key signatures.

nodes.title: Scale degrees by number
nodes.objective: Number the degrees of a scale and name the degree of a note in a Grade 1 key.

nodes.title: Practice: Major scales and keys
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: The tonic triad
nodes.objective: Build and recognise tonic triads in C, G, D and F major in both clefs.

nodes.title: Interval numbers
nodes.objective: Count letter names to give the number of an interval.

nodes.title: Intervals above the tonic
nodes.objective: Identify and write intervals above the tonic in C, G, D and F major, harmonic and melodic.

nodes.title: Practice: Triads and intervals
nodes.objective: Mixed independent practice of everything in this unit.

nodes.title: Review: earlier units
nodes.objective: Spaced review of earlier units in this grade, mixed with the new unit.

nodes.title: Unit challenge: Triads and intervals
nodes.objective: Show independently, without hints, what you can do from this unit.

nodes.title: How fast? Tempo terms
nodes.objective: Understand common tempo terms and metronome marks.

nodes.title: How loud? Dynamics
nodes.objective: Understand dynamic marks and hairpins.

nodes.title: Directions and signs
nodes.objective: Follow repeat marks, pause, 8va and other performance directions.

nodes.title: Articulation
nodes.objective: Recognise staccato, accent and legato markings.

nodes.title: Looking closely at a melody
nodes.objective: Answer questions about an original melody using everything from Grade 1.
